template: multiply(group_zscore(winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4), industry), subtract(1, multiply(0.5, group_zscore(winsorize(ts_delta(winsorize(ts_std_dev(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 60), std=4), 20), std=4), industry))))
idea: 双维度中性化交叉增强：同时在行业维度对背离度和波动率变化进行中性化（group_zscore），通过波动率变化的标准化分值动态调整背离度权重。构造“行业内相对背离优势”与“行业内信息收敛速度”的复合信号。
expression_list: multiply(group_zscore(winsorize(vec_avg(success_likelihood_score) - ts_mean(vec_avg(success_likelihood_score), 30) * ((vec_avg(expected_exit_price) / vec_avg(anl90_openprice)) / ts_mean(vec_avg(expected_exit_price) / vec_avg(anl90_openprice), 30)), std=4), industry), subtract(1, multiply(0.5, group_zscore(winsorize(ts_delta(winsorize(ts_std_dev(vec_avg(success_likelihood_score), 60), std=4), 20), std=4), industry))))
